text:
erin: Quick heads-up  starting a short, surgical entitlement sweep next week focusing on analytics+infra svc accounts. Owners will be pinged to confirm admin entitlements.

lee: noted. two safety asks: (1) please exempt any grants with an `incident_tag` or created during deploy windows, (2) postpone auto-demote for principals with NULL requestor until we can backfill audit payloads.

mike: saw ~56 grants in the last 72h for svc-analytics-*; a bunch were short-lived. do we have a good way to mark temporary elevations so the prune job doesn't hit them?

anya: we added `temporary_elevation` in infra#3245 last quarter. issue is some SDK paths still don't set it. i'll run a quick extract of grants missing that flag.

access-bot: Automation notice: entitlement cleanup "svc-analytic-prune" scheduled 2026-04-14T03:00Z. Current grace_days=7. To request change, open PR infra/tools/admin-prune#update-grace.

erin: let's make a conservative change for this run: set grace_days=14 and skip grants matching `metadata->>'incident_tag' IS NOT NULL OR metadata->>'deploy_tag' IS NOT NULL`. Also add a manual column in the review sheet for `temporary_elevation` so owners can override.

lee: i'll open infra PR to set grace_days=14 and add an `exclude_incident_tags` flag. i'll also push a small migration to backfill `grant_origin` from audit_events. snippet i'll run: 
```
UPDATE kms_grants g
SET grant_origin = e.source
FROM audit_events e
WHERE e.grant_id = g.grant_id
  AND g.grant_origin IS NULL;
```

mike: thanks. i'll prepare a whitelist of grants to exclude: incident-tagged, deploy-tagged, and any with `created_at >= now() - INTERVAL '14 days'`. will share CSV by Tue EOD.

anya: note: we still have an audit gap from the 03/22 webhook deploy. some grants created in that window have no audit_events. i can try to backfill from s3 raw payloads; if unmatched, i'll tag `audit_gap=true` and we should exempt for this pass.

erin: good. don't demote if `audit_gap=true`. owners can mark them manually after we reconcile. also please ensure the review export includes `grant_origin` and `requestor` columns.

access-bot: Action queued: pending PR infra/tools/admin-prune#change-grace-14d. To add exemption rules submit PR label `prune-exemptions`.

lee: will make webhook idempotent too; last sweep had duplicates from retries. i'll also add `incident_id` into grant metadata when elevations come from oncall workflows so automation can filter. infra#3330 created.

mike: small vuln coordination note: vuln-triage flagged a key rotation in progress for svc-analytics-deployer. please do not demote until rotation completes. i'll include a `remediation_status` column in the CSV.

anya: backfill plan: (1) scan s3 prefix `audit-webhooks/2026/03/22/` for matching grant ids, (2) correlate with raw nginx logs for request bodies, (3) tag unmatched grants as `audit_gap`. will post progress in infra#3331.

erin: perfect. plan recap: (1) lee -> infra PR to set grace_days=14, add exclude flag, idempotent webhook + incident_id, (2) anya -> backfill audit payloads and tag audit_gap if needed, (3) mike -> whitelist CSV with remediation_status and deploy/incident tags by Tue EOD, (4) owners -> use review sheet column `temporary_elevation` to override automation. Pause prune if new churn appears.

lee: one more thing: make the demotion job skip grants where `requestor IS NULL AND owner_email IS NULL` until we finish backfill. safer default.

mike: ack. i'll include that rule in the whitelist generation query: 
```
SELECT grant_id, principal, created_at, requestor, owner_email, grant_origin, metadata
FROM kms_grants
WHERE principal LIKE 'svc-analytics-%'
  AND (created_at < now() - INTERVAL '14 days')
  AND (metadata->>'incident_tag' IS NULL OR metadata->>'deploy_tag' IS NULL)
ORDER BY created_at DESC;
```

access-bot: Summary: grace_days change pending, exemptions include incident_tag/deploy_tag/audit_gap, owners will get review pings. To pause the job comment `pause svc-analytic-prune` in the infra PR.

erin: thanks team. small ask: if anyone sees a spike in KMS grant churn while we roll these changes, ping here immediately and we'll halt. :hand:

lee: will post PR link and ETA for webhook change in 2h.

anya: starting s3 backfill now. will report matches/unmatched in infra#3331 within 3h.

mike: sharing CSV by Tue EOD as promised.

erin: closing loop: we'll run the prune next Fri after whitelist and backfill complete. appreciate the rapid turnaround.

access-bot: Logged actions: infra#3330, infra#3331, infra/tools/admin-prune#change-grace-14d."
